item.title: Simon Willison's Blog
item.description:
Simon Willison writes frequently and specifically about AI coding tools — hands-on reviews, careful benchmarking, and clear-eyed commentary that cuts through a lot of the surrounding hype.

Particularly useful for grounded takes on how well a new tool or model actually performs at real coding tasks, rather than marketing claims.

item.title: Claude API
item.description: The Claude API skill is a language-aware reference for the Anthropic SDK and Messages API — model selection, adaptive thinking, streaming, prompt caching, token counting, and tool/MCP integration — with explicit guidance to verify API shapes against live docs rather than a model’s memorized training data.
